description: Rooms for the given dates and guests with the from-price per night in EUR and the booking page URL. If "source" is "mock", prices are placeholders: send the guest to booking_url. With "online_booking": true each room lists booking_options (house, room_type, rate_id, rate, price per night, total incl. city tax): pass the chosen option to start_booking. Never books anything: the guest books on the site, via start_booking, or asks with request_offer.

departure.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD, after the arrival.

house.description: Only this house. Leave out for all houses.

language.description: Language of texts and links: de, nl, en. Default de.

room_id.description: Only this room type (id from list_rooms).

name: check_availability

code.description: Error code when ok is false, e.g. VALIDATION, NOT_FOUND, UNAVAILABLE.

message.description: Readable error message when ok is false.

ok.description: true on success; false with code and message on an error.

title: Rooms and prices for dates
